translation: Woman: I am a woman who should be wearing jewels set with stones... (Then wear them, did I ever say no?) Aa... aa... Jewels set with stones, jewels set with stones, jewels set with stones, I am one who should be wearing them... I am one who should be wearing jewels set with stones... but you wrote copper rings into my fate...

Medicine man, medicine man, medicine man, oh you trickster, come here, maama, my young baava... Medicine man, oh you trickster, come here, maama, my young baava... Takadinakari takadinakari takita takita takita takita taa (refrain)...

Man: Hey, every other word you call me medicine man, damn it... At every word, again and again, at every word you call me medicine man?... At every word you call me medicine man?... As if you never knew from the start that I was a medicine man... O my Charamma, O my Charamma, O my Charamma, my darling beauty... O Govindamma, my picture on the wall... O my Charamma, my darling beauty... O Govindamma, my picture on the wall... Takadinakari takadinakari takita takita takita takita taa...
Woman: Fine rice... fine rice... I am one who should be eating fine rice... I am one who should be eating fine rice... but you wrote coarse gruel into my fate...

Medicine man, medicine man, medicine man, oh you trickster, come here, maama, my young baava... Medicine man, oh you trickster, come here, maama, my young baava... Takadinakari takadinakari takita takita takita takita taa...

Man: Hey, the same words again, what is it, you she-demon... At every word, again and again, at every word you call me medicine man?... Again and again you call me medicine man?... As if you never knew from the start that I was a medicine man... O my Charamma, O my Charamma, O my Charamma, my darling beauty... O Govindamma, my picture on the wall... O my Charamma, my darling beauty... O Govindamma, my picture on the wall... Takadinakari takadinakari takita takita takita takita taa...

Woman: In mansions and terraced houses... in mansions and terraced houses... I am one who should be living in mansions and terraced houses... I am one who should be living in mansions and terraced houses... but you wrote thatched huts into my fate...

Medicine man, medicine man, medicine man, oh you trickster, come here, maama, my young baava... Medicine man, oh you trickster, come here, maama, my young baava... Takadinakari takadinakari takita takita takita takita taa...

Man: Hey, may your lips and nose drop off... At every word, again and again, at every word you call me medicine man?... Again and again you call me medicine man?... As if you never knew from the start that I was a medicine man... O my Charamma, O my Charamma, O my Charamma, my darling beauty... O Govindamma, my picture on the wall... O my Charamma, my darling beauty... O Govindamma, my picture on the wall... Takadinakari takadinakari takita takita takita takita taa...
Woman: Silk saris... silk saris... I am one who should be wearing silk saris... I am one who should be wearing silk saris... but you wrote torn saris into my fate...

Medicine man, medicine man, medicine man, oh you trickster, come here, maama, my young baava... Medicine man, oh you trickster, come here, maama, my young baava... Takadinakari takadinakari takita takita takita takita taa...

Man: Hey, why do you keep saying the same thing again, hey... At every word, again and again, at every word you call me medicine man?... Again and again you call me medicine man?... As if you never knew from the start that I was a medicine man... O my Charamma, O my Charamma, O my Charamma, my darling beauty... O Govindamma, my picture on the wall... O my Charamma, my darling beauty... O Govindamma, my picture on the wall... Takadinakari takadinakari takita takita takita takita taa...
Laalalaa lalalaalalaa laalalaa lalalaalalaa... (x2) Nanananaa nanananaa nanananaa nanananaa nanananaa nanananaa nanananaa nanananaa nananaa
summaryEn:
Manduloda Ori is a playful romantic duet in the form of a lovers' quarrel. The woman calls her man 'manduloda', a man of medicines or charms, and 'mayaloda', a trickster, hinting that he won her over with some kind of spell. She also calls him by the affectionate kinship terms 'maama' and 'baava', which Telugu women often use for a husband or sweetheart. In each verse she sets the life she deserved against the life he has 'written into her fate': jewels set with stones against copper rings, fine rice against coarse gruel, mansions against thatched huts, silk saris against torn ones.

The man answers with mock irritation rather than real anger. He grumbles at being called 'medicine man' at every turn, throws out comic curses such as 'she-demon' and 'may your lips and nose drop off', and insists she knew what he was from the start. Then he softens at once into endearments, calling her Charamma, Govindamma, his darling and his 'picture on the wall'. The song is built on call and response between the two voices, with a fixed refrain after each complaint and the drum-like syllables 'takadinakari takita', which give it a lively dance rhythm. It closes with 'lalala' and 'nanana' vocables.
summaryTe:
మందులోడా ఓరి ఒక ప్రేమ జంట మధ్య సరదాగా సాగే గొడవ రూపంలో ఉన్న యుగళ గీతం. ఆమె తన మనిషిని 'మందులోడా', 'మాయలోడా' అని పిలుస్తూ, ఏదో మందు మాయ చేసి తనను వలలో వేసుకున్నాడని సూచిస్తుంది. అదే సమయంలో 'మామ', 'బావ' వంటి ఆప్యాయమైన బంధుత్వ పిలుపులతోనూ పిలుస్తుంది; తెలుగు స్త్రీలు భర్తను లేదా ప్రియుడిని ఇలా పిలవడం సాధారణం. ప్రతి చరణంలో తాను అనుభవించాల్సిన జీవితాన్ని, అతను తన నొసట రాసిన జీవితంతో పోలుస్తుంది: రాళ్ళ నగలకు బదులు రాగి ఉంగరాలు, సన్న బియ్యానికి బదులు అంబలి, మేడ మిద్దెలకు బదులు పూరి గుడిసెలు, సిలుకు చీరలకు బదులు చిరిగిన చీరలు.

అతను నిజమైన కోపంతో కాకుండా ఉత్తుత్తి చిరాకుతో బదులిస్తాడు. మాట మాటకూ మందులోడా అంటావా అని గొణుగుతూ, 'రాక్షసి', 'మూతి ముక్కు రాలిపోతదే' వంటి నవ్వు తెప్పించే తిట్లు విసురుతాడు; తాను ఎలాంటివాడినో ముందే తెలుసు కదా అంటాడు. వెంటనే మెత్తబడి 'నా చారమ్మో', 'గోవిందమ్మో', 'ముద్దుల గుమ్మా', 'గోడ మీది బొమ్మా' అంటూ ముద్దుగా పిలుస్తాడు. ఇద్దరి గొంతుల మధ్య ప్రశ్న-జవాబుల్లా సాగే ఈ పాటలో ప్రతి ఫిర్యాదు తర్వాత ఒకే పల్లవి, 'తకదినకరి తకిట' వంటి డప్పు తాళపు శబ్దాలు వచ్చి నృత్యానికి అనువైన ఉత్సాహభరితమైన లయను ఇస్తాయి. చివరికి 'లాలలా', 'ననననా' అనే కూతలతో పాట ముగుస్తుంది.
